task.title: How to Subtract Numbers
task.shortdesc: Here you will find instructions about using the subtraction feature of the JPS Calculator app.

taskbody.prereq: To successfully subtract numbers, you must know what is subtraction.
taskbody.result: The result from the subtration is displayed.
taskbody.example: You want to subtract 2 from 3. The equation will look like: 3-2=1. You enter 3. Press minus. Enter 2. Press the equal button.
